rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for behaving with excessive pride or self-importance.

example.english: He has been speaking to people haughtily ever since he got promoted.
example.traditional: 佢升咗職之後成日趾高氣揚咁同人講嘢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1 zi1 hau6 seng4 jat6 zi2 gou1 hei3 joeng4 gam3 tung4 jan4 gong2 je5

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when the haughty manner also comes across as rude, cocky, or looking down on others.

example.english: Don't haughtily tell people that they are slow.
example.traditional: 你唔好串串貢咁話人哋做得慢。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 cyun3 cyun3 gung3 gam3 waa6 jan4 dei6 zou6 dak1 maan6

rows.note: Use this when the person acts as though they are socially or intellectually above everyone else.

example.english: That professor haughtily criticized our ideas.
example.traditional: 嗰位教授高高在上咁批評我哋嘅諗法。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 gaau3 sau6 gou1 gou1 zoi6 soeng6 gam3 pai1 ping4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 nam2 faat3
